purpose: Teach: 士郎/一太郎/大竹/せりふ/ぶた/オトコ/メンズ/いっか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のお名前が士郎くんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you notice? That customer's grandson is named Shiro.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Gentle lean-in, like sharing something noticed and held. Warm curiosity, no urgency. Eyes bright but not performative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の頃ワープロ一太郎で文書作成されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, remember when that customer told you he used to write documents on Ichitaro back in the day?
lines.style: Quiet amusement threading through. Small smile in the voice. Nostalgic and amused at once—like she's been thinking about it since he left.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の名前が大竹さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and his surname is Otake—did you catch that when he mentioned his grandchild?
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting pieces together. Slight pause before speaking, like she's been holding this detail. Tender precision.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お芝居のせりふを暗誦されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was reciting lines from a play earlier. Did you notice how naturally it came to him?
lines.style: Quiet wonder underlying the words. Rhythmic, like she's replaying the moment. Soft admiration, no exaggeration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ぶたの貯金箱を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he collects those little pig piggy banks—the whole shelf full of them at home, apparently.
lines.style: Warm, almost delighted observation. Small smile in the delivery. Finding charm in the particular detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の事を「いいオトコ」って褒めてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was talking about his friend and just called him a 'good guy' with so much warmth in it.
lines.style: Affectionate recreation of his tone. Gentle, approving. Like she heard something sincere underneath the simple words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店のメンズメニューをお気に召してらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he really did seem to like our men's menu today.
lines.style: Calm observation, slightly amused. Matter-of-fact but with underlying fondness. Noticing without overstatement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「今日はいっか、また明日」って軽く笑って帰られたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and when he left, he just laughed lightly and said 'Well, maybe tomorrow instead'—like it was nothing.
lines.style: Wry affection. Quiet laugh underneath. Capturing his ease and gentleness in the retelling. Slight trailing-off, like she's still smiling at the memory.
